Not a wait-state or context-dependent fragment. Every other chunk (checked all 13) carries bullets or paragraphs with a self-carrying claim of its own.

Checked each header against its own chunk's content: "Sharpen the skill from evidence" (chunk 5) content is exactly that prompt; "Clear the session" (chunk 7) content is the wrap-and-/clear sequence; "Bring to Module 4" (chunk 10) content states the one task to bring; "Pre-read before Module 4" (chunk 11) content is one optional read. No "Not X. Not Y. Z." triples, no anaphora/epistrophe triples, no self-grading superlatives, no abstraction-noun stacks, no empty-leg verb triplets anywhere in the body_numbered projection. The two bolded floor/ceiling lines (chunk 2 line 14: "A feature you could ship in a few hours. Not a quarter-long epic."; chunk 10 line 95: "One scoped task you'd send off rather than nudge bit by bit: a real slice. Bigger than a typo-fix, smaller than an epic.") are single X./Not-Y. pairs matching the §34 task-sizing shape, not the banned three-leg construction. "Too small... Too large..." (chunk 2 line 12) is a contrasting pair, not a triple.
